+  - **Google AI Overviews**: Dominated by YouTube, which holds a 200x citation advantage over other video sources.

+  - Journalism accounts for 27% of all AI citations but rises to 49% for time-sensitive queries.
+  - User-generated content (UGC) structurally outweighs journalism for non-time-sensitive queries.
+  - Claude cites journalism from the past 12 months at a 36% rate, compared to 56% for ChatGPT.
+- **Strategic Priorities**:
+  - Audit brand presence across the top 15 sources before addressing the long tail.
+  - Treat Wikipedia as foundational infrastructure.
+  - Build Reddit as a strategic, evergreen channel.
+  - Map journalism targets to specific platform citation patterns.
+  - Plan for volatility as a baseline condition, not a tail risk.
